First public build.

Governor discovers the kernel interfaces available on a device instead of assuming a
CPU layout or fixed frequency table. It includes guarded CPU and GPU controls, profiles
and triggers, read-only thermal monitoring, and battery-draw comparisons.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer and root through Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch. Device
testing so far is on a rooted Poco F3; the README lists the remaining test coverage.

The APK is signed with Governor's release certificate. Its SHA-256 checksum is attached.
Builds installed from the earlier debug APK use a different certificate and must be
uninstalled before installing this release; uninstalling removes the app's data.
